identity.name: El País English
identity.description: The English-language edition of Spain's leading progressive daily, covering Spanish and Latin American politics, Europe and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: El País is owned by the Spanish media conglomerate PRISA. The English edition translates and curates selected Spanish-language reporting for international readers.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Established newspaper with a public editorial line and professional newsroom; PRISA ownership and Spanish political ties create commercial pressures but no direct state control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates El País Left-Center with High factual reporting; its editorial line is social-democratic and pro-European.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage generally supports a mixed economy and European social model rather than a pure market programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Spanish and EU lens with substantial Latin American coverage and a pro-European integration outlook.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established newspaper of record with named reporters and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Spanish progressive internationalism, with strong European and Latin American coverage and a social-democratic editorial outlook.

selectionRationale: Adds a major Spanish-language publisher's English edition and strong Latin American coverage, filling a gap in the catalog.

research.researchNotes: Official English About page returned 404. Ownership from PRISA and Wikipedia. Feed validated. English edition is a curated translation product, not the full Spanish newsroom. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
